# config

ConfigMaps mounted as files (axiz-common, <app>, <app>-errors; no Kubernetes API access), Parameter Store, required keys check

```bash
axiz add config
```

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Starter | `pe.axiz:axiz-config-spring-boot-starter` |
| Incluida por defecto en | experience, business, process, integration, event-processor, batch, crud |

## Propiedades que agrega

Valores por defecto seguros en `application.yaml`; los valores de cada ambiente van en el ConfigMap del servicio y los secretos en el secret store.

```yaml
axiz.config.environment: ${AXIZ_ENVIRONMENT:local}
```

## Uso

```java
axiz.config.required: [axiz.http-client.clients.core.base-url]
```
